title: The Man Who Remembered Everything
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：memory　|　正文 393 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 memory 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Memory, he said, is a job like any other. My uncle was not the eldest, the richest or the most capable, and he became the head of our family anyway, because he was the one who ① remembered. Not sentimentally: he kept a list. Every ② memory in that house — who owed what, whose roof leaked, which cousin had not answered — lived in a notebook he carried for forty-one years.

Memory, in our family, was not a talent but an obligation. I used to think this was a burden he had chosen. It was a duty nobody had given him and nobody could take away. There is no ③ memory of anybody thanking him. What there is, in my own ④ memory, is the sound of the notebook opening at the start of every visit, which meant the list was going to be read aloud.

Memory, he said once, costs a Tuesday. He had a rule about the dead. Nothing is ⑤ in memory of a person, he said, if it is only a bench; a bench is a place to sit, and a duty is a thing you do on a Tuesday. He was ⑥ memorably unpopular for saying it at a funeral, and said it again at the next, which is the part I admire.

The notebook went with him everywhere, including into hospital in 2011. He ⑦ memorised none of it — he was not a performing wonder, and he distrusted people who were — but he had written it down, and writing it down was the whole method. Every memory he wrote down, he said, was a debt with a name on it. The ⑧ memory on my phone holds four thousand photographs and not one promise. What he had, I now see, was not a memory at all: it was a system, and a system is a thing anybody can be taught.

He died in 2013. Memory, in the end, is what the family now lacks. The family, left to itself, forgot two funerals and one wedding within a year, which he would have predicted and did. There is a ⑨ memory I keep returning to: him at eighty asking a cousin whether the roof had been fixed, and opening the notebook anyway. ⑩ Memory, he once told me, is not what you feel about people. It is what you are willing to be accountable for.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 记忆（能力）；记性
B. n. 回忆；留在记忆中的事
C. n. 纪念；怀念（in memory of）
D. adv. 显著地；值得记住地（memorably）
E. v. 记住；背诵；熟记（memorise）
F. n. 存储器；内存（计算机）
G. 固定搭配：in memory of 为纪念……
H. n. 记忆所及；人们记得的范围（within memory）

items.q: because he was the one who remembered
There is no memory of anybody thanking him
in my own memory, is the sound of the notebook opening
Nothing is in memory of a person
he was memorably unpopular for saying it
The memory on my phone holds four thousand photographs
There is a memory I keep returning to
Memory, he once told me, is not what you feel about people

answers.why: 此处指他“记得、记性好”，说全家因为他肯记住事情而听他的。
memory 指“被记住的事、记忆中的条目”，说那屋里每一件需要记住的事都在本子上。
no memory of 意为“记忆中从未有过、不记得有过”，说没人记得有人谢过他。
in one's memory 意为“在某人的记忆里”，说我记得的是本子翻开的声音。
in memory of 意为“为纪念……”，说只立一条长椅算不上纪念一个人。
memorably 作副词，意为“显著地、令人难忘地”，说他在葬礼上说这话而极不受欢迎。
memorise 作动词，意为“背诵、记住”，说他并没有把内容背下来。
memory 指电子设备的“存储器、内存”，说我手机里存了四千张照片却没有一个承诺。
指一段“回忆”，说我反复想起的那个场景。
Memory 抽象化为“纪念、怀念（的义务）”，说它不是你对人的感情而是你愿意承担的责任。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 他成了家里的主事人，因为他是那个肯记住事情的人。（remember）
那屋里每一件要记住的事都写在他带了四十一个春秋的本子上。（memory）
在我的记忆里，是每次登门时本子翻开的声音。（in one's memory）
只立一条长椅，算不上纪念一个人。（in memory of）
他在葬礼上说这话，因而极不受欢迎。（memorably）
他并没有把本子上的内容背下来。（memorise）
answers: He became the head of the family because he was the one who remembered.
Every memory in that house lived in a notebook he carried for forty-one years.
In my own memory, it is the sound of the notebook opening at the start of every visit.
A bench is nothing in memory of a person.
He was memorably unpopular for saying it at a funeral.
